pages.text:
Breaks the block in front of it with FE and keeps the drops in its 9 slots, sending them out through its Output faces (Wrought tier). It can face any direction.
- No tool needed: it drops what the right tool would (stone gives cobblestone, iron ore gives raw iron). Harder blocks take longer and cost more FE.
- It never breaks unbreakable blocks or parts of Arcforge multiblocks.
- Redstone: Always, With signal, Without signal, or Pulse (one block per redstone pulse).
